label: 885,596 ha of likely koala habitat cleared
detail: At least 885,596 hectares of forest and woodland that was known or likely koala habitat was cleared (WWF-Australia)
source: Parliament of Australia, Senate inquiry report ch. 2

label: Listed as Vulnerable
detail: East-coast koalas first listed as vulnerable under national law

label: Black Summer bushfires
detail: Estimates of koala deaths range from at least 6,400 to about 61,000; more than 500,000 ha of forest burnt
source: Australian Geographic; Senate inquiry report ch. 2

label: Upgraded to Endangered
detail: On 11 February 2022 the koala was uplisted from Vulnerable to Endangered in QLD, NSW and the ACT
source: Parliament of Australia, Senate inquiry report ch. 2

label: A$24.5m Saving Native Species
detail: May 2022: A$24.5 million over four years; total koala investment above A$70 million over four years
source: Parliament of Australia, Senate inquiry report ch. 2

label: National Recovery Plan
detail: A national recovery plan for the koala was released in 2022 (the inquiry report gives March and April)
source: Parliament of Australia, Senate inquiry report ch. 2

label: National monitoring estimate
detail: National Koala Monitoring Program: 95,000 to 238,000 listed koalas
source: Australian Koala Foundation media release, 5 Nov 2025

label: Survey effort expands
detail: National Koala Monitoring Program: 398,000 to 569,000 listed koalas. Not a proven population increase
